frozen_question: Does the same ordinary D2_PATH/(0,0)/LEFT exact relation response that separated all 4,520 S1 states remain separating on a fresh, higher three-atom G6 panel generated after S2R? If not, do the preregistered larger one-step observers separate the collisions, or does a nontrivial higher behavior quotient remain?

axis_A_complete_00_motifs.description: Complete fixed-(0,0),(0,0) three-atom family over all ordered triples of the four S0 basis carriers and both binary bracketings; enumerate every exact final outcome and deduplicate structurally.

axis_B_adversarial_h4.description: Deterministic disjoint-from-S2-independent-sample stress panel: select the 128 S1 exact states with lexicographically largest exact-canon SHA-256 and enumerate every exact child under four frozen ordinary continuations.
axis_B_adversarial_h4.sample_rule: 128 S1 exact states with lexicographically largest SHA-256 of exact structural canon; S2R independent verification used lexicographically smallest 128.

higher_panel.union_rule: Union all exact outcomes from axes A and B, deduplicate by full exact unrooted structural canon, and require every resulting carrier to be outside the certified S1 universe.

independent_verification.method: Independent manual cross-edge construction plus independent unrooted canon for every context actually used by the selected observer level.
independent_verification.sample_rule: 128 fresh higher states with lexicographically smallest exact-canon SHA-256.

observer_ladder.contexts: D2_PATH x all 31 frozen operators x LEFT/RIGHT; includes L1
all four S0 probes x all 31 frozen operators x LEFT/RIGHT; includes L2

promotion_constraints: No S3R result promotes C3, the L1 response, hidden topology/canon, or any new public descriptor.
A discrete higher kernel is scoped evidence on the frozen higher panel only.
A nontrivial L3 quotient is candidate-only input for a newly frozen S4/review branch.
purpose: Challenge the scoped G6:S2R single-context separation result on genuinely new three-atom/higher G6 carriers before any descriptor promotion or S4 closure claim.
stopping_rules: freshness failure: any higher-panel state is already in S1 universe
first observer level yielding a discrete partition
completion of L3 with a nontrivial partition

test_protocol.checkpointing: Generation and observer evaluations are durably sharded; existing hash-bound shards are reused on exact resume only.
test_protocol.collision_evidence: Preserve exact structural witness pairs and their complete response sets for the first surviving collision at each nonterminal level.
test_protocol.decision_equality: Full canonical structural tuples only; SHA-256 may index states, freeze samples, and bind evidence but never decides scientific equality.
test_protocol.generation: Enumerate complete exact relation outcomes for every registered higher-panel generation context, then structurally deduplicate.
test_protocol.monotonicity: If L1 or L2 is injective, every registered superset observer is injective on the same frozen higher universe.
test_protocol.partition_refinement: Evaluate the observer ladder only on states still in non-singleton response classes; stop at the first discrete partition.
